D: An undersized racehorse and a team of broken men become a symbol of hope during the Depression.
P: Serve the snacks before the big match race against War Admiral.
S: Roasted peanuts with smoked paprika, cayenne and brown sugar

Warm roasted peanuts tossed with butter, smoked paprika, brown sugar and sea salt, served in paper bags like at the track. Toss 400g raw unsalted peanuts with 30g melted butter, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until deep golden. Cool for 10 minutes so the coating crisps, then serve in paper bags.
Seabiscuit's apple and cheddar hand pies
Hand pies filled with cinnamon apple and cheddar

Flaky little hand pies filled with cinnamon apple and sharp cheddar, baked golden and sprinkled with sugar. Cook 3 peeled diced apples with 30g butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 6 minutes until soft, then cool. Cut 8 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry. Put a spoon of apple and a few cubes of cheddar from 100g on each, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sugar and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden.
M: Pan-fried crab cakes with paprika chips and slaw

Maryland-style crab cakes seasoned with celery salt and paprika, seared golden and served with crunchy slaw, lemon and spiced chips. Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp celery salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and 60g panko. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side. Bake 800g frozen chips and toss with paprika salt. Toss shredded cabbage with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and vinegar. Serve with lemon wedges.
W: Cinnamon apple pie with a buttery crumble top and ice cream

Deep cinnamon apple pie with a crumbly brown sugar streusel top, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Peel and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and toss with 80g caster sugar, 2 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp cornflour. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill. Rub 60g butter into 80g plain flour and 60g brown sugar and scatter over the top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes until golden and bubbling. Cool 20 minutes and serve with ice cream.
K: Honey orange black tea with mint over ice

Black tea brewed with honey and orange peel, chilled and mixed with fresh orange juice, poured over plenty of ice with mint. Steep 5 black tea bags in 800ml boiling water with 3 tbsp honey and strips of peel from 1 orange for 5 minutes. Remove the bags and peel, then chill for 1 hour. Stir in the juice of 3 oranges. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour over the tea and garnish with orange slices and mint.
